blurb: The Woodfin Ridge Golf Course provides many outstanding natural characteristics. At 7,107 yards from the championship tees , the course carves through all reaches of the property, making its way along creeks, streams and scenic Lake Bowen. With the Blue Ridge Mountains framing the course, Jacob's Creek winds through the heart of the second, third and fourth holes.
